Collection of videos on how to use TAK.

Youtube channels to follow

  • ATAK Map https://www.youtube.com/@ATAKMap
    • "Official" TAK Videos and presentations.
  • TAK Syndicate https://www.youtube.com/@thetaksyndicate6234
    • TAK community of public safety users (California FD TAK) https://www.thetaksyndicate.org/
  • CoTAK https://www.youtube.com/@coetak
    • TAK community of public safety users (Colorado FD TAK) https://cotak.gov/
  • ATAK Wizard https://www.youtube.com/@ATAKwizard/
    • Individual doing short instructions videos of TAK (Currently not actively publishing).
  • myTeckNet https://www.youtube.com/@myTeckNet_Vids
